L00_lineup: Use image 1 for the exact character designs of Yejin (the white Bichon puppy) and Pip (the yellow duckling) and for the soft clay-and-plush art style; use image 2 only for the style of the grass, flowers and sky. Create the Clover Meadow set: a sunny rolling green meadow full of clover with small yellow and coral wildflowers, one big round tree on the right with a short white picket fence behind it, a small clear shallow puddle in the left foreground with a few reeds, soft green hills and a tiny red barn far in the background. Wide eye-level shot from the front. In the middle of the meadow sit, left to right: Yejin, the little lamb and Pip, all facing the camera and smiling. Yejin is the round fluffy white Bichon puppy whose head is a large perfectly round fluffy ball with no visible ears, black eyes and nose, pink cheeks, no clothing; her head is about the same width as her body. The little lamb is a small round lamb with cloud-like curly cream-white fleece, a soft peach-beige face, tiny leaf-shaped ears tucked flat into the fleece, short stubby legs with little gray hooves and a small mint-green ribbon collar with a tiny gold bell; she is a little smaller than Yejin. Pip is the small round yellow duckling with an orange beak and a sky-blue knitted scarf, exactly as in the reference. Only these three characters, no other animals or people. Clear bright blue sky with a few white clouds, warm late-morning sun from the upper left, never sunset. Soft clay-and-plush 3D preschool animation style, low contrast, pastel palette, 16:9 film still. No text, no letters, no logos.
